NOTE: Independent (20 Jul 2026) — Trump Truth Social claims Burnham will open North Sea oil "all the way"; branded UK "Poverty Stricken Disaster"; Lucy Powell says Burnham sticks to manifesto, "change of emphasis" not policy.
Trump: Burnham "will be opening up, all the way, the invaluable North Sea Oil" and move the "horrible looking windmills". Claimed drilling would make the UK "from a Poverty Stricken Disaster, to one of the Richest Countries anywhere in the World". Rosebank/Jackdaw fields (licences already granted) the focus. Powell: not expecting "change of policy" but "more a change of emphasis".
